note: Realistic filled-in states in the AUDIT-C scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. Flags: this is a split engine, so the detector is pinned as expected.flaggedIssues via flagsHint "detectFlaggedIssues" with flagsArgs ["state","result.auditcScore"], mirroring form-app.js's call detectFlaggedIssues(state, grade.auditcScore); the wall clock is frozen at the oracle's default while grading.

personas.name: lower-risk
personas.description: Occasional light drinker: Q1 1, Q2 0, Q3 0 — AUDIT-C 1, lower-risk band, negative screen.
